title: CMMSContext
description: Live-fetched CMMS records (CRs and WOs) scoped to the RCA event. Fetched at RCA invocation time from the plant CMMS. Narrative text is also injected into the run-scoped Chroma collection for semantic retrieval. Persisted as cmms_context.json in the run artifact store.

adapter.description: Class name of the CMMSContextAdapter that produced this context.

lookback_anchor.description: What drove the lookback window start date.

lookback_from.description: Start of the CMMS query window (inclusive). Derived from last PM date on the primary asset, or fallback.

lookback_to.description: End of the CMMS query window (inclusive). Typically the event timestamp.

sister_component_ids.description: KG component IDs identified as sister equipment and included in the CMMS query scope. Flat list for backward compatibility — use sister_components[] for match type provenance.

sister_components.description: Sister equipment with match type provenance. Superset of sister_component_ids. Absent when no similarity resolver is configured.

match_type.description: How the sister was identified. Topology-only: 'topology'. Similarity-only: 'failure_mode_overlap', 'spec_embedding', 'fm_overlap+spec_embedding'. Combined: 'topology+failure_mode_overlap', 'topology+spec_embedding', 'topology+fm_overlap+spec_embedding'.

shared_fm_count.description: Number of shared failure modes (Tier 2). 0 for topology-only or embedding-only matches.

embedding_score.description: Chroma similarity distance (Tier 3). 0.0 for topology-only or FM-overlap-only matches. Lower = more similar.

cr_records.description: Corrective Action records from the CMMS within the lookback window, scoped to primary asset and sister equipment.

cr_type.description: CMMS record type (e.g. CAL, CAP, PM for Maximo; M1, M2 for SAP PM).

long_text.description: Full CR narrative. Also embedded and injected into Chroma for semantic retrieval.

component_id.description: KG component_id matched from functional_location or equipment_id. Null if unresolved.

days_before_event.description: Days between created_date and the event timestamp. Negative = after event (data lag).

is_sister_equipment.description: True if this record belongs to sister equipment, not the primary asset.

wo_records.description: Work Order records from the CMMS within the lookback window.

recurrence_summary.description: Derived aggregate — computed by CMMSContextBuilder, not from CMMS directly.
